vibe.verdict: Right laundromat, right bagel and hot dog fingers, but most dish notes are plain and the rock universe and the hibachi raccoon get no real moment.
missing: Evelyn and Joy as rocks on the cliff (rock universe)
Raccacoonie and Chad at the teppanyaki grill (hibachi universe)
Deirdre's pile of receipts and the karaoke machine (IRS meeting)
Googly eye stuck on Evelyn's forehead (the finale)
Waymond's kindness speech (fight in the IRS building)
ideas: Swap the plain note on 'Hibachi steak and prawn fried rice' for 'Chad cooks. Raccacoonie runs the grill.'
Swap the note on 'Sesame balls' for 'Two rocks on a cliff, talking in subtitles.'
Swap the 'Overheard: Deirdre the IRS auditor' footer for 'Deirdre sees a story in every receipt.'
Swap the note on 'Bubble tea' for 'Googly eye on the forehead optional.'
